def recursive_solve(n, i):
    base_count = i * (n // ones[i])
    n %= ones[i]
    if n == 0:
        return base_count
    option_a = i + recursive_solve(ones[i] - n, i - 1)
    option_b = recursive_solve(n, i - 1)
    return base_count + min(option_a, option_b)
